scope: Separate exploratory funding audit only; no canonical accounting or eligibility change

rationale.statement: Official historical-rate example has a nonzero millisecond offset; this does not guarantee all rows fall within one second.

rules.wallHour: H must be an exact UTC hour and >= effectiveFirstWallHour
rules.rate: Exactly one actual fundingHistory row per market with finite fundingRate and integer time T in inclusive [H,H+999ms]. Reject absent, duplicate or out-of-window rows; never use predicted funding.
rules.timestamp: Preserve T and H separately; association is a modeled assumption, not exact settlement-time proof. No raw timestamp rewrite.
rules.oracle: Use existing complete finite preceding-oracle-30s receipt at or before H with receipt age<=30000ms and request duration<=5000ms; do not use receipt after H.
rules.quantity: Reconstruct exclusively from chronological saved paper fills; explicit Hyperliquid source venue required. Reject fills within inclusive [H-1000,H+1000ms] as ambiguous, negative/nonfinite quantity or unknown actions.
rules.calculation: Modeled USDC = -signed saved paper quantity * selected spot oracle * actual rate; long positive quantity, short negative. Exact funding remains false.
rules.missing: Never infer zero or interpolate; report eligibility denominators and exclusions.
rules.accounting: No change to canonical cash/P&L/fundingComplete; no historical backfill or relabeling of strict prior results.
rules.family: One prospective association rule only; no search over timestamp windows or best-results selection.

validationNext: Implement and test exact/in-window/out-of-window/duplicate and ambiguous-leg cases, then audit first eligible hour after15:00Z; no performance-readiness inference.
status: Preregistered design; implementation and prospective result pending
